KQBY.note: Reached 2 via small-case gcds and partial Wilson analysis; rigorous factoring not visible, middle omitted.

EKTR.note: Answer 2 from checking n<=8 and a flawed parity argument; no rigorous maximum proof visible.

QUEU.note: Algebra wrongly concluded gcd always 1, then self-corrected by trying small n; answer 2 is empirical, not derived.

XWSH.note: Computed B-(n+1)A = -(n+1)(n-1), reduced gcd correctly, then confirmed with cases; answer 2.

UCMV.note: Used difference n(n!+1), briefly miscomputed gcd 6 at n=6, later settled on 2 by small cases.

TRTW.note: Long case enumeration and confused parity/prime analysis; no visible reduction to (n-1)(n+1); ran out of tokens without answer.

DZTD.note: Factored x^2+x-20, cleared denominators, matched coefficients: G=1, H=2.

VNXA.note: Factored denominators, equated numerators, matched coefficients, checked consistency.

VZNQ.note: Factored RHS denominator to x(x+5)(x-4), matched coefficients correctly.

RTYF.note: Found common denominator, factored quadratic by trial, solved coefficient system.

EGEN.note: Factored x^2+x-20, equated numerators, solved G=1, H=2.

GNTW.note: Factored via quadratic formula, matched coefficients, got H/G=2.

SKQT.note: Substituted x=sqrt2*y, factored (y+1)(2y^2+4y+3) correctly, then mis-simplified back-substitution to imaginary part sqrt2/2 instead of 1.

TUSB.note: Ansatz factor failed, switched to x=sqrt2*y, factored cubic in y, back-substituted correctly: -sqrt2, -sqrt2 plus/minus i.

TSPV.note: Found root -sqrt2 but synthetic division with radicals was wrong (quotient x^2+2sqrt2x+5sqrt2); never checked; wrong complex roots.

UAVN.note: Obtained correct (x+sqrt2)(x^2+2sqrt2x+3) but answered only the real root, ignoring the complex roots requested by 'all solutions'.

XSQU.note: Guessed root -sqrt2, long division gave correct quadratic, complex roots computed correctly.

QPMC.note: Tested x=-sqrt2, divided exactly, solved quadratic giving -sqrt2 plus/minus i.

PPXN.note: Used closed form sum of cubes, 231^2 = 53361, units digit 1; alternative route, no pairing.

JBGH.note: Closed form 231^2, checked mod 10 and by direct squaring; units digit 1.

MABS.note: Summed units digits of cubes (total 91) and cross-checked with closed form; answer 1.

TXPZ.note: Verified closed form on small n, computed 231^2 = 53361, units digit 1.

DRBJ.note: Closed form 53361, then second check by listing units digits (sum 91); answer 1.

QFJA.note: Listed all 21 cubes, summed units digits to 91, units digit 1; brute force but valid.

YECA.note: Simplified tan sum, factored x^4-1, cancelled x^2+1, solved x^2-x-1=0, rejected negative root by sign argument.

KCVF.note: Same x^4-1 factoring and cancellation; long numeric validity checks; eventually rejected (1-sqrt5)/2 since sum is -3pi/4.

BZGH.note: Mis-simplified fraction to (x^2+1)/(x^2(x^4-1)), never factored x^4-1 to cancel; solved wrong sextic, gave x=plus/minus sqrt(phi).

RKGX.note: Factored x^4-1 and got both roots correctly, then spiralled into contradictory validity checks about the negative root until the cap; no boxed answer.

ZSNE.note: Factored x^4-1, cancelled x^2+1, solved quadratic; numeric check confirmed positive root, rejected negative root.

SCVH.note: Same simplification slip gave x^6-2x^2-1; long detour; later factored x^4-x^3-x-1=(x^2+1)(x^2-x-1) but cap hit before final answer.

UCNF.note: Set (x^2-sx-32)(x^2-tx+62) but wrote x-coefficient as -32t+sp (sign error), got t=458/47, then guessed t=12 to reach 102.

GACF.note: Took product of roots as +1984 (sign error), so cd=-62; long integer-pair search and botched quadratic split; cap hit without answer.

DXVD.note: Wrote (a+b)(c+d)+ab+cd correctly but used r3r4=-62 (product-of-roots sign error); dead end, long guessing, cap hit.

MHBM.note: Found r3r4=62, grouped to k=30+ab, matched (x^2-ax-32)(x^2-bx+62), solved a=4, b=14, k=86.

RPCS.note: Correct k=30+ST and equation, but judged 376/94=188/47 non-integer (it equals 4); doubted correct setup, tried rational roots until cap.

PMKF.note: Grouped k=30+ST, factored as (x^2-Sx-32)(x^2-Tx+62), solved S=4, T=14, k=86.

VWVV.note: Got a^2+b^2+c^2=1, ab+bc+ca=0, S=+-1, then p3=S^3+3abc gives 4 and 2 (Newton route, equivalent).

HGCX.note: Same route; briefly wrote 4 or -2 (arithmetic slip), self-corrected to 4 and 2; final boxed 2, 4.

EGQA.note: Briefly claimed 4 and -4, corrected; final text states boxed 2 and boxed 4, but extractor kept only 4 and marked WRONG.

FVWP.note: Used the a^3+b^3+c^3-3abc factorization giving 3+S; final answer 2 and 4 in separate boxes, extractor took only 4.

ZSMD.note: Circulant square gives conditions, S=+-1, p3=S^3+3 gives 4 and 2; boxed '2 and 4'.

KATP.note: Correct S^3+3 with S=+-1, then computed -1+3 as -2 instead of 2; answer 4 or -2.

JWQC.note: Factored r^3-s^3, cancelled r-s, used (r+s)^2-rs = 31/4, answer 31.

KNGF.note: Vieta first, then cube-difference factoring and cancellation; 4*(31/4) = 31.

SSUW.note: Factored cube difference, computed r^2+s^2=53/4, then 31/4; answer 31.

VSZE.note: Vieta, cube-difference factoring, cancellation, 31/4 times 4 equals 31.

item_notes.math:number_theory/train/00126: Five answers reached 2 mostly by small-case gcd checks with flawed or partial algebra; only XWSH visibly derived -(n+1)(n-1). The capped run drifted into confused parity and prime analysis.
item_notes.math:algebra/train/01030: Easy item. All six factored the denominators, cleared fractions and matched coefficients. No failures.
item_notes.math:intermediate_algebra/train/00004: Nobody recognised (x+sqrt2)^3. All guessed or scaled to find root -sqrt2. Failures were radical arithmetic (division, back-substitution) and omitting the complex roots.
item_notes.math:number_theory/test/00090: All six used the closed form or summed units digits. None used the pairing n and 20-n. Easy item, no failures.

item_notes.omni:omni/00173: Correct runs used k=30+(r1+r2)(r3+r4) with the quadratic split. Failures: sign slips (product of roots, x-coefficient), a 376/94 reduction error, then long unproductive searches to the cap.
item_notes.math:precalculus/train/00152: All used the Newton/cubic identity route with S=+-1. Failures: one arithmetic slip (-1+3=-2) and two grader extraction errors, where separate boxed 2 and 4 were read as only 4.
item_notes.math:intermediate_algebra/train/00196: Easy item. All six factored r^3-s^3, cancelled r-s and evaluated with Vieta. No failures.
